title: Registry
statement: Implement `solve(kind, message)`. `kind` is `email`, `sms`, or something else. A registry maps known kinds to constructors. Return the send result `kind:message` for a known kind. Return `error` for an unknown kind. Do not use a long if chain in the send path.
constraints: The message is passed to send
hints: Look up the kind. A miss returns error.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: A registry turns a new channel into a registration instead of a new branch in the caller.

editorial: A registry turns a new channel into a registration instead of a new branch in the caller. The lookup failure is the unknown-kind error. Constructing on use keeps the registry from holding live connections it does not need yet.
